Meta.title: Salon Kupferglanz
Meta.description: Hair salon in Vienna — cut, color, and care with character.
Meta.homeTitle: Hair Salon in Vienna — Cut, Color & Care
Meta.homeDescription: Salon Kupferglanz in Vienna: individual cuts, balayage and color concepts, care and treatments. Appointments by arrangement.

Home.heroTagline: Personal style. Professional color. Your salon in Vienna.
Home.dna1Body: Every appointment starts with a conversation about hair structure, your routine and how much upkeep you want — free and without obligation, even if you decide against booking.
Home.dna2Body: You book a stylist with their own focus, not just "the salon". Who does what is there to see on the team page.
Home.dna3Body: You hear what your appointment costs before we begin, not at the till. Every guide price is listed openly.
Home.workBody: A glimpse of what takes shape here.
Home.workImageAlt: Hair styled at Salon Kupferglanz by {name}
Home.teamBody: Three stylists, one shared standard: craft with character.
Home.locationArrival: Two minutes' walk from U3 Neubaugasse, with tram 49 stopping around the corner. Short-stay parking along the whole street, and the Mariahilfer Straße garage is about five minutes away.

Leistungen.title: Services & Prices
Leistungen.subtitle: Transparent pricing for every occasion — no surprises.
Leistungen.metaDescription: Every price at Salon Kupferglanz in Vienna: women's and men's cuts, balayage, root colour, Olaplex and treatments — with durations and answers to the most common questions.
Leistungen.disclaimer: Final cost can vary depending on hair length, effort, and the result you're after.

Kontakt.title: Contact
Kontakt.subtitle: Write to us or give us a call — we'd love to see you.
Kontakt.metaDescription: Salon Kupferglanz, Kupfergasse 8, 1060 Vienna: opening hours, phone number, how to get here by underground and tram, plus a contact form.
Kontakt.arrivalBody: U3 Neubaugasse, two minutes on foot. Tram 49 stops around the corner. Short-stay parking along the whole street, and the Mariahilfer Straße garage is about five minutes away.
Kontakt.formIntro: For a confirmed appointment, a quick call is fastest — messages sent through this form get an answer within one working day.
